mapper.select:
SELECT FINPROD_ID ID, NVL(FINPROD_ABBR, FINPROD_NAME) TEXT FROM FIN_PRODUCT
FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01','F07','F17','F18') AND FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL
and (instr(FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(FINPROD_ABBR,#{search}) > 0 or instr(FINPROD_NAME, #{search}) > 0)
and FINPROD_ID = #{initValue}

SELECT TFAT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, TFAT.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, TFAT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, FPA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, TFAT.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, TFAT.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, TFAT.INT_AMT intAmt, TDTA.CLEAR_REC_AMT clearRecAmt, TDTA.PENALTY_INTAMT penaltyIntAmt, TDTA.CLEAR_LOSS_AMT clearLossAmt FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TFAT INNER JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TFAT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON TFAT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_add FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE TFAT.BUSI_TYPE = 'TRD75' AND TFAT.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TFAT.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND TFAT.TRADE_DATE >=to_date(#{clearDateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND TFAT.TRADE_DATE <=to_date(#{clearDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND TFAT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
AND TFAT.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL

SELECT D.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, B.CHL_ID secAcctId, B.INV_AIM invAim, B.FINPROD_ID finprodId, B.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, B.CCY ccy, B.TRADE_ID totleTradeId, M.HODING_TYPE hodingType, B.SHARE_AMT shareAmt FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD D ON D.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW M ON M.PORTFOLIO_ID = D.PORTFOLIO_ID AND M.CDATE = B.TRADE_DATE WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND B.SHARE_AMT IS NOT NULL AND B.TRADE_STATUS != '03' and rownum=1

SELECT M.* FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW M WHERE exists( select B.TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND B.SHARE_AMT IS NOT NULL AND B.TRADE_STATUS != '03' AND M.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID )

SELECT M.* FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW M WHERE exists( select B.TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND B.SHARE_AMT IS NOT NULL AND B.TRADE_STATUS != '03' AND M.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID )

SELECT M.* FROM PTL_RECE_POSITION_FLOW M WHERE exists( select B.TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND B.TRADE_STATUS != '03' AND M.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID )

SELECT DISTINCT TEMP.portfolioId AS portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, TEMP.secAcctId AS secAcctId, CASE TEMP.secAcctId WHEN '999999' THEN null ELSE TEMP.secAcctId END AS secAcctIdName, TEMP.invAim AS invAim, CASE FP.FINPROD_TYPE WHEN 'F07' THEN null ELSE TEMP.invAimName END AS invAimName, TEMP.shareAmt AS shareAmt, CASE FP.FINPROD_TYPE WHEN 'F01' THEN TEMP.shareAmt*(100-nvl(YZFBJ.prinAmt,0)) ELSE TEMP.shareAmt END AS prinAmt, TEMP.receAmt AS clearRecAmt, TEMP.penaltyIntAmt AS penaltyIntAmt, TEMP.tdyIntincexp AS intAmt, TEMP.tdyLossAmt AS clearLossAmt, FP.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 AS finprodType2, TEMP.finprodId AS finprodId, TEMP.ccy AS ccy, CASE FP.FINPROD_TYPE WHEN 'F01' THEN (100-nvl(YZFBJ.prinAmt,0)) ELSE null END AS unitValue, FP.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket FROM ( ( SELECT PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, PSV.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, PSV.SEC_ACCT_ID AS secAcctId, PSV.INV_AIM AS invAim, SDL.ITEM_CODE || SDL.ITEM_VALUE invAimName, PSV.SHARE_AMT AS shareAmt, SUM(PSR.RECE_AMT) AS receAmt, SUM(PSR.PENALTY_INT_AMT) AS penaltyIntAmt, PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP AS tdyIntincexp, PSV.TDY_LOSS_AMT AS tdyLossAmt, PSV.CCY AS ccy FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL ON SDL.ITEM_CODE = PSV.INV_AIM AND SDL.DICT_CODE = 'INV_AIM' LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES PSR ON PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSR.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSV.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSR.SEC_ACCT_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = PSR.INV_AIM AND PSV.FINPROD_ID = PSR.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.CDATE = PSR.CDATE AND PSV.CCY = PSR.CCY AND PSR.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId} WHERE PSV.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND PSV.TDY_LOSS_AMT != 0 AND PSV.TDY_LOSS_AMT IS NOT NULL AND PSV.CDATE = to_date(#{clearDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSV.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSV.INV_AIM, SDL.ITEM_CODE || SDL.ITEM_VALUE, PSV.FINPROD_ID, PSV.CCY, PSV.SHARE_AMT, PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP, PSV.TDY_LOSS_AMT )TEMP LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON TEMP.portfolioId = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON TEMP.finprodId = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F01','F07','F17','F21') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FCP.FINPROD_ID, SUM(FCP.PRIN_AMT) AS prinAmt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO FCI INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID AND FCP.CASH_TYPE = '02' AND FCP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND FCP.BRANCH = 0 AND FCP.MDATE <=to_date(#{clearDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') WHERE FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = '01' group by FCP.FINPROD_ID )YZFBJ ON TEMP.finprodId = YZFBJ.FINPROD_ID )

SELECT TF.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TF WHERE TF.BUSI_TYPE = 'TRD75' AND TF.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{clearDateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TF.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND TF.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TF.IS_CANCEL = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT WF.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WF WHERE WF.BUSI_TYPE = 'TRD75' AND WF.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{clearDateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND WF.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
SELECT REPLACE(LPAD(${sequenceName}.NEXTVAL, 4), ' ', '0') FROM DUAL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F28' AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '02' AND FPA.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT * FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}
SELECT * FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND trade_status != '03'
SELECT * FROM TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}

SELECT * FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD B LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D ON B.TRADE_ID = D.TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T on T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = D.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND T.trade_status != '03'

SELECT * FROM PTL_TRADE B LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D ON D.TRADE_ID = B.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T ON T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = D.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} AND T.trade_status != '03'

SELECT D.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, B.FINPROD_ID finprodId, M.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, B.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, D.CHL_ID secAcctId, SDL.ITEM_CODE || SDL.ITEM_VALUE invAim, D.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, D.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, D.INT_AMT intAmt, T.CLEAR_REC_AMT clearRecAmt, T.PENALTY_INTAMT penaltyIntAmt, T.CLEAR_LOSS_AMT clearLossAmt FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL B LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL D ON B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = D.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND D.PS = 'T75' LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD T ON D.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON D.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT M ON D.FINPROD_ID = M.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL ON SDL.ITEM_CODE = D.INV_AIM AND SDL.DICT_CODE = 'INV_AIM' WHERE B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}
UPDATE TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL SET TRADE_STATUS = '01',IS_CANCEL = 'Y' WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}
UPDATE TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL SET TRADE_STATUS = '01',IS_CANCEL = 'Y' WHERE P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}
UPDATE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL SET TRADE_STATUS = '01',IS_CANCEL = 'Y' WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select count(1) from ( select FINPROD_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where BUSI_TYPE = 'TRD75' AND TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{clearDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND IS_CANCEL = 'N' UNION ALL select FINPROD_ID from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where BUSI_TYPE = 'TRD75' AND TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{clearDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioId} )
